verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's Vertex AI is referenced as a platform for building agentic systems and enterprise-grade AI agents, implying managed model access, but the evidence pack lacks concrete documentation of the inference API surface, model catalog (frontier vs open models), or endpoint/SDK usage details. Missing for 10: explicit API reference docs for Vertex AI model inference, mention of specific frontier/open model support (e.g., Gemini, Llama), and client library/code examples for calling hosted models.
